name: Hovanes "Hov" Tonoyan
office: City of Burbank, Member of the City Council

items.text: In 2024, Hovanes Tonoyan worked as a cybersecurity professional at The Walt Disney Company. He studied political science at UC Berkeley and has gained experience with the California State Assembly, the Burbank Chamber of Commerce, and the City of Burbank. His campaign says he wants affordable water and power rates, responsive public safety, and housing decisions that respect existing neighborhoods while giving renters protections. He told the Burbank Tenants Union he is inclined toward a 5% cap on annual rent increases and supports a rental registry if it can be done without much cost.
